name: Creative Studio Project CLI
purpose: Project lifecycle CLI for multi-format creative projects: scaffold from a project template, vendor the studio runtime, generate per-format entry files, validate brief/storyboard/project/composition, plan or run HyperFrames builds per format, approximate captions, and record the creative review.
capabilities: new: scaffold projects/<slug>/ from templates/projects/<id>/ with brief, storyboard, project.json and composition
sync: copy src/studio/ into projects/<slug>/src/_studio/ with a SHA-256 lock (refuses to overwrite local edits)
formats: write src/index.<format>.html entry files for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 from one index.html
validate: JSON Schema checks, catalogue status of capabilities, reading-time floors, determinism lint, font policy, stale generated files
build: per-format render plan (HyperFrames --composition), audio mux and QA gates; legacy projects delegate to scripts/build-project.sh

captions: approximate cues from measured narration timing (WebVTT + src/captions.js); --timing words transcribes each clip locally (hyperframes transcribe, under the analysis lock), aligns the script to the measured word times and writes audio/words.json; --grouping phrase makes 1-3 word reel captions
words: film time at which a phrase is spoken (from audio/words.json), to snap a storyboard beat to its noun
script: pre-render script and story lint (timed sentence sheet, hook, abstract runs, loop, asks, storyboard why-table); validate prints its warnings
hook: score hook lines (a lint, not a view predictor) and list the formulas in specs/hook-formulas.json
review: creative-review rubric with evidence and pass rule

upgrade: re-sync the runtime and regenerate entry files for named projects or --all (including projects/<group>/<version>/), moving every render it supersedes to renders/history/<format>/<when>/ and its out/ copy to out/archive/, with a history.json naming the changed src/ files

renders: per-format render state (current, stale with the changed files, unstamped, missing); --archive [--unstamped] moves stale renders to history; build also archives a stale render before re-rendering it instead of overwriting it

compatibility.notes: new/sync/formats/validate/captions/review/status and build --dry-run verified on Windows (Python 3.14). Real builds need HyperFrames + FFmpeg on the production Mac and have not been run with this tool yet.

security.notes: Writes only inside projects/<slug>/ and out/ (build delivers there; upgrade, renders --archive and build move superseded deliverables to out/archive/). build invokes hyperframes, ffmpeg and the QA script as subprocesses with argument lists (no shell).

approval_evidence: tests/test-studio.py on Windows; build path unverified until a Mac render. Promote after a full build + QA run on the M2 host.
